_schema: Identity key: sport|year|product|configuration. Optional: sku, upc, manufacturerProductCode. image.url is only trusted when image.verified=true and image.source is a real, named source. configuration is required to render - a record with configuration=null must not be matched against a UI request for a specific configuration (e.g. Hobby).
_purpose: Exact sealed-product image registry. Replaces app.html's PRODIMG (brand-only) and part of BOX_ART/REALPROD. A missing exact configuration match must render an image-unavailable state, never a substitute.

image.source: Local asset, provenance not documented in-repo

images.notes: Local file but configuration label ('hobby-box photography') is unenforced free text today, not a structured field. Needs source documentation before verified=true.
FLAGGED: third-party hotlink, not a local asset. Recommend replacing with a manufacturer-sourced or CardStorm-localized image before this is presented as verified. See report Step 4.
